{{a|Embody Aspect}} ([[Terastal phenomenon|Terastallized states]]) |current=[[Party|With]] the {{player}} |media=game }} '''Ogerpon''' (Japanese: '''オーガポン''' ''Ogerpon''), referred by the [[Kitakami]] people as the '''Ogre''' (Japanese: '''鬼''' ''Ogre)'', is a {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} and a major character in {{g|Scarlet and Violet}}'s [[The Teal Mask]] [[Downloadable content|DLC]]. After an incident between it, {{ga|Pecharunt}} and its [[Loyal Three|retainers]], all believed it to be a monstrous ogre that tried to attack the village. [[Kieran]], however, is the only one who believes that Ogerpon isn't that bad. ==In the core series games== {{spoilers}} ===History=== ====Background==== [[File:Ogerpon partner masks.jpg|250px|thumb|left|Ogerpon and its partner masked during the [[Festival of Masks]]]] Initially, Ogerpon and its former partner came to the land of [[Kitakami]] from a foreign land. They were shunned by the people of the [[Mossui Town|village]] due to their strange appearance, and so they lived in a [[Oni Mountain|nearby mountain]], isolated from the villagers. Although it saddened the pair that the villagers were not welcoming, they were happy to live quietly with each other. The village mask-maker took pity on the pair and crafted four beautiful masks for them, allowing them to blend in with the people during the village festival, which made the pair overjoyed. [[File:Loyal Three fight Ogerpon.png|250px|thumb|right|Ogerpon confronting the [[Loyal Three]] and {{ga|Pecharunt}}.]] However, their fame would become a new source of tragedy for Ogerpon, as the attention-seeking {{ga|Pecharunt}} had been tasked by an old couple under its control to pilfer the masks for them. Pecharunt brought its mind-controlled retainers — {{p|Okidogi}}, {{p|Munkidori}}, and {{p|Fezandipiti}} — who tracked down Ogerpon's lair and attempted to steal all four masks while it was away. Ogerpon's partner returned and tried to stop them, but in the ensuing scuffle, only the Teal Mask could be protected, and when Ogerpon returned, there was no trace of its partner, but evidence of a great struggle. Perhaps if only to search for its friend, filled with rage, Ogerpon attacked and slayed the three Retainer Pokémon and knocked Pecharunt out, but its anger caused the villagers to fear it even more. Thus, Okidogi, Munkidori, and Fezandipiti were immortalized by the unaware villagers as the [[Loyal Three]], while Ogerpon was left alone in its cave, saddened by the events that had transpired. Although the village mask maker desperately attempted to tell the truth of the matter, nobody in the village took him seriously. In order to prevent further generations of his family from being persecuted for this truth much like he was, he passed down the true story as a family secret, which later made its way to his descendant [[Yukito]], a Kitakami native. As a result of the villagers' interpretation of the event, there is a myth that Ogerpon will supposedly steal the souls of humans without masks late at night. Since then, it resided in the [[Dreaded Den]]. It also occasionally travelled down during the Festival of Masks pretending to be a child to have fun in it with no one noticing it. ===={{g|Scarlet and Violet}}==== =====[[The Teal Mask]]===== [[File:OgerponFestival.jpg|250px|left|thumb|Ogerpon after dropping its [[Teal Mask]]]] During the Mask Festival, the player and their [[friend]] [[Carmine]] meet Ogerpon, mistaking it as a child. Ogerpon dropped its [[Teal Mask|mask]] and ran away after being seen at the outskirts of the festival. Unbeknownst to Ogerpon, the player and Carmine fix the damaged mask with the help of her grandfather. After the [[Loyal Three]] are suddenly revived, they stole Ogerpon's three other masks (the [[Wellspring Mask]], [[Hearthflame Mask]], and [[Cornerstone Mask]]) and started attacking the Mask Pokémon at the Dreaded Den, who appeared defenseless. They were chased off by the player and Carmine, who returned the Teal Mask. [[Kieran]] attempted to do so initially, but presumably due to being saved by the player and meeting them initially at the festival, they only accept the mask when done so with the player. Following this, Ogerpon now walks alongside the player wherever they go in Kitakami. Initially when brought to the village, it appears scared of entering even with the player and their friends. Ogerpon is asked to stay outside the village whilst Kieran, Carmine and the player gather clues about the Loyal Three's current whereabouts, though only does so after the player makes the suggestion themselves, much to Carmine's chagrin. After enough clues have been gathered as to {{p|Okidogi}}, {{p|Munkidori}}, and {{p|Fezandipiti}}'s locations in Kitakami, it watches the player and Carmine's [[Multi Battle]]s against the now [[Titan Pokémon|titanic-sized]] members of the Loyal Three, happily posing in pictures after each mask is retrieved. After retrieving the masks, Kieran tells the player, Carmine and Ogerpon to return to [[Mossui Town]]. Once they arrived, they learned that he had told the truth to all the villagers, which led them to profusely apologize to Ogerpon, despite its initial hesitation to enter the village. The group returns to the Dreaden Den to bid farewell to Ogerpon, but it runs over to the player and implies that it wants to travel with them. This irritates Kieran, who, after having dreamed of meeting Ogerpon since he was a small child, challenges the player to a battle to win its affection, despite Carmine's reminder that it's Ogerpon's choice as to who it decides to travel with. After his defeat, the game claims that Ogerpon wants to test its strength against the player, and gives them the choice to accept. During their battle, it Terastallizes its Hearthflame Mask, Wellspring Mask, Cornerstone Mask, and Teal Mask in four consecutive battles with no interruptions, with the masks gaining power due to Ogerpon's strong memories and determination following its journey with the player. The Teal Mask in particular invokes the memories of its former partner from many years ago for a final boost in strength, before allowing itself to be captured by the player, where it entrusts them with the [[form|transformation]] masks. It participates in a final battle against Carmine as per the Trainer's request, before the events of The Teal Mask come to a close. =====[[The Indigo Disk]]===== Though Ogerpon does not play any real role in the story, if it is used in battle against Carmine, she will happily greet it and wonders if it missed her that badly. On the other hand, during the Champion match with Kieran, his accumulated bitterness will lead to him lashing out against Ogerpon and telling the player they have some nerve for taunting him by using "the ogre" against him in battle. =====[[Mochi Mayhem]]===== [[File:Ogerpon VS Pecharunt Reaction.png|thumb|250px|Ogerpon angered by seeing Pecharunt in battle again]] If the player uses Ogerpon during the battle against {{ga|Pecharunt}}, Ogerpon will recognize it and show great distress and anger, madly yelling at it for everything it and the [[Loyal Three]] had done to Ogerpon and its partner in the past. ===Personality and characteristics=== {{main|Ogerpon (Pokémon)}} [[File:OgerponHappy.jpg|250px|thumb|left|Ogerpon excited to join the player]] Ogerpon has a curious and mischievous personality. It appears to long for partnership, as evidenced by it tentatively approaching the ongoing Kitakami Festival, attempting to blend in with the villagers while wearing a mask. When its face is initially seen by the player and their friend, it's understandably shy due to being shunned by humans. After being saved by the player following the revival of the Loyal Three, it warms up to them over the events of The Teal Mask. As a result, it often ignores Carmine's orders, and only listens to the player. It's clear that Ogerpon thinks about its previous partner even after warming up to the player, with the partner being implied to have fallen at the hands of the Loyal Three. Ogerpon's experience of being seen as an outcast when initially coming to Kitakami had an impact on other characters such as Carmine (following the reveal of its true history), who was initially cold to outsiders coming to her village, as well as Kieran, who, being shy and introverted, admired its strength in defeating the Loyal Three. Although normally a gentle and playful Pokémon, it can be a force to be reckoned with if infuriated, best evidenced by how it single-handedly defeated both the Loyal Three and Pecharunt, despite the enormous type-disadvantage stacked against it. Ogerpon carries a deep grudge against {{ga|Pecharunt}} and the [[Loyal Three]] for their previous actions towards it and its partner. ===Appearance=== :''See also: [[Ogerpon (Pokémon)#Form data|Ogerpon → Form data]]'' Ogerpon has four forms, which each have their own unique [[Terastal phenomenon|Terastallized state]]. The masks created for Ogerpon and its partner are given power by Ogerpon's intense emotions, which cause a significant change to its appearance when Terastallized, unlike most other Pokémon. {|
